rules.name: cash-refresh-23-tolerance-and-incident-cfs
rules.sql: SELECT value_date,settlement_date, (value_date=:valueDate::date AND settlement_date=:cob::date) AS dates_match, (:prevCob::date=coalesce((SELECT settlement_date FROM opera.vdate_sdate_table WHERE tenant_id=:tenant AND value_date=:cob), (SELECT max(cob_date) FROM opera.client_cash_account_balance_table WHERE tenant_id=:tenant AND upper(trim(business_unit))=:bu AND cob_date<:cob))) AS previous_date_matches, (SELECT count(*) FROM opera.client_cash_account_balance_table b WHERE b.tenant_id=:tenant AND upper(trim(b.business_unit))=:bu AND b.cob_date=:prevCob) AS previous_balance_rows FROM opera.valuation_date_table WHERE tenant_id=:tenant AND upper(trim(business_unit))=:bu

WITH cb_refresh_input AS MATERIALIZED ( SELECT r.tenant_id, r.business_unit, r.trade_id, r.value_date, r.settlement_date, r.instrument, r.subportfolio, r.product_code, r.derivative_type, r.original_lots, r.active_lots, r.currency, r.transaction_date, r.maturity_date, r.contract_month, r.future_expiry, r.counterparty_parent, CASE WHEN upper(trim(r.counterparty_parent))='SIPH' AND lower(trim(r.derivative_type))='avg_swap_cc' THEN 'SIP' ELSE r.client_code END AS client_code, r.contract_number, r.original_premium, r.lot_mult, r.curr_mult, r.mult_factor, r.nc_factor, r.fx_nc_factor, r.netting_date, r.netting_status, r.opt_periodicity, r.is_premium_paid, r.fixing_date, r.settle_price, r.netted_lots FROM opera.fn_cash_balance_report_for_scope(:tenant, :bu) r WHERE r.tenant_id=:tenant AND upper(trim(r.business_unit))=:bu AND ((nullif(trim(r.client_code),'') IS NOT NULL AND lower(trim(r.client_code))<>'null') OR (upper(trim(r.counterparty_parent))='SIPH' AND lower(trim(r.derivative_type))='avg_swap_cc')) ), cb_refresh_previous AS MATERIALIZED ( SELECT upper(trim(client_code)) AS client_code, upper(trim(currency)) AS currency, opening_balance, expired_or_liquidated_cash, premium_paid_or_recd, commission, transfers_in, transfers_out, interest_charges, closing_balance, comments, client_name FROM opera.client_cash_account_balance_table WHERE tenant_id=:tenant AND upper(trim(business_unit))=:bu AND cob_date=:prevCob), cb_refresh_today AS MATERIALIZED ( SELECT upper(trim(client_code)) AS client_code, upper(trim(currency)) AS currency, opening_balance, expired_or_liquidated_cash, premium_paid_or_recd, commission, transfers_in, transfers_out, interest_charges, closing_balance, comments, client_name FROM opera.client_cash_account_balance_table WHERE tenant_id=:tenant AND upper(trim(business_unit))=:bu AND cob_date=:cob), cb_refresh_threshold AS MATERIALIZED ( SELECT upper(btrim(t.client_code)) AS client_code, coalesce(nullif(upper(btrim(t.currency)), ''), 'USD') AS currency FROM opera.client_threshold_master t WHERE t.tenant_id = :tenant AND upper(btrim(t.business_unit)) = :bu ), cb_refresh_spot AS MATERIALIZED ( SELECT upper(btrim(m.currency)) AS currency, upper(btrim(m.quantotype)) AS quantotype FROM opera.currency_spot_mapping_table m WHERE m.tenant_id = :tenant ), cb_refresh_fixings AS MATERIALIZED ( SELECT upper(btrim(f.client_code)) AS client_code, upper(btrim(f.derivative_type)) AS derivative_type, upper(btrim(f.product_code)) AS product_code, upper(btrim(f.currency)) AS currency, f.expired_fixing, f.premium_fixing FROM opera.client_account_cash_balance_fixing_table f WHERE f.tenant_id = :tenant AND upper(btrim(f.business_unit)) = :bu AND f.cob_date = :cob ), cb_refresh_movements AS MATERIALIZED ( WITH inputs AS ( SELECT upper(btrim(r.client_code)) AS client_code, upper(coalesce(btrim(r.contract_number), '')) AS contract_number, upper(coalesce(btrim(r.derivative_type), '')) AS derivative_type, upper(coalesce(btrim(r.product_code), '')) AS product_code, upper(coalesce(btrim(r.currency), '')) AS currency, coalesce(r.original_premium::float8, 0) AS original_premium, coalesce(r.original_lots::float8, 0) AS original_lots, coalesce(r.active_lots, 0) AS active_lots, coalesce(r.netted_lots, 0) AS netted_lots, coalesce(r.mult_factor, 0) AS multiplier, r.settle_price IS NOT NULL AND r.settle_price <> 'NaN'::float8 AS has_price, coalesce(nullif(r.settle_price, 'NaN'::float8), 0) AS settle_price, coalesce(r.nc_factor, 0) AS nc_factor, coalesce(r.fx_nc_factor, 0) AS fx_nc_factor, coalesce(left(lower(btrim(r.derivative_type)), 10) = 'fx_vanilla', false) AS fx_option, coalesce(left(lower(btrim(r.derivative_type)), 10) = 'fx_forward', false) AS fx_forward, coalesce(left(lower(btrim(r.derivative_type)), 8) = 'avg_swap', false) AS avg_swap, coalesce(lower(btrim(r.derivative_type)) = 'future', false) AS future, coalesce(lower(btrim(r.netting_status)), '') <> 'not_netted' AS netted, coalesce(r.is_premium_paid = 1, false) AS paid, r.maturity_date, r.transaction_date, r.netting_date FROM cb_refresh_input r ), events AS ( SELECT i.*, coalesce(fx_option AND paid AND transaction_date = :cob, false) AS fx_premium, coalesce(fx_option AND paid AND maturity_date = :cob, false) AS fx_cash, coalesce(fx_option AND NOT paid AND maturity_date = :cob, false) AS fx_realised, coalesce(fx_option AND NOT paid AND netting_date = :valueDate, false) AS fx_netted FROM inputs i ), amounts AS ( SELECT e.*, CASE WHEN fx_cash OR fx_realised THEN CASE WHEN has_price THEN -settle_price * active_lots * multiplier ELSE 0 END WHEN fx_option OR NOT has_price THEN 0 ELSE (settle_price - original_premium) * active_lots * multiplier * -1 END AS m2m_nc, CASE WHEN paid AND netting_date = :valueDate AND transaction_date IS DISTINCT FROM :cob AND derivative_type IN ('VANILLA_CALL','VANILLA_PUT','AMER_UP_IN_CALL','AMER_UP_IN_PUT', 'AMER_DOWN_IN_CALL','AMER_DOWN_IN_PUT','AMER_UP_OUT_CALL','AMER_UP_OUT_PUT', 'AMER_DOWN_OUT_CALL','AMER_DOWN_OUT_PUT','EURO_UP_OUT_CALL','EURO_DOWN_OUT_PUT', 'EURO_UP_IN_CALL','EURO_DOWN_IN_PUT','CS_SPREAD_CALL','CS_SPREAD_PUT') THEN 0 WHEN fx_netted THEN original_premium * netted_lots * multiplier WHEN fx_realised THEN original_premium * active_lots * multiplier WHEN fx_premium THEN original_premium * original_lots * multiplier WHEN fx_option THEN 0 WHEN netted AND maturity_date = :cob THEN original_premium * active_lots * multiplier WHEN netted THEN original_premium * netted_lots * multiplier ELSE original_premium * original_lots * multiplier END AS premium FROM events e ) SELECT client_code, contract_number, derivative_type, product_code, CASE WHEN fx_forward THEN 'USD' ELSE currency END AS currency, CASE WHEN future OR fx_option OR avg_swap THEN m2m_nc WHEN fx_forward THEN m2m_nc * nc_factor * fx_nc_factor ELSE 0 END AS expired, CASE WHEN NOT (future OR fx_forward OR fx_option OR avg_swap) OR fx_premium OR fx_realised OR fx_netted THEN premium ELSE 0 END AS premium FROM amounts ), cb_refresh_groups AS MATERIALIZED ( SELECT grouping(contract_number) = 0 AS is_contract, contract_number, client_code, derivative_type, product_code, currency, coalesce(sum(nullif(expired, 'NaN'::float8)), 0) AS expired, coalesce(sum(nullif(premium, 'NaN'::float8)), 0) AS premium FROM cb_refresh_movements GROUP BY GROUPING SETS ((client_code, derivative_type, product_code, currency), (contract_number, client_code, derivative_type, product_code, currency)) ), cb_refresh_converted AS MATERIALIZED ( WITH rates AS ( SELECT g.*, coalesce(f.expired_fixing, 1) AS expired_fixing, coalesce(f.premium_fixing, 1) AS premium_fixing, upper(btrim(m.quantotype)) = 'DIVISION' AS division FROM cb_refresh_groups g LEFT JOIN cb_refresh_groups retained ON NOT retained.is_contract AND retained.client_code = g.client_code AND retained.derivative_type = g.derivative_type AND retained.product_code = g.product_code AND retained.currency = g.currency AND (abs(retained.expired) > 1e-10 OR abs(retained.premium) > 1e-10) LEFT JOIN cb_refresh_fixings f ON f.client_code = g.client_code AND f.derivative_type = g.derivative_type AND f.product_code = g.product_code AND f.currency = g.currency AND (NOT g.is_contract OR retained.client_code IS NOT NULL) LEFT JOIN cb_refresh_spot m ON m.currency = g.currency ), converted AS ( SELECT r.*, x.kind, CASE WHEN NOT coalesce(division, false) THEN x.amount * x.rate WHEN x.amount = 'NaN'::float8 OR x.rate = 'NaN'::float8 THEN 'NaN'::float8 WHEN x.rate = 0 THEN CASE WHEN x.amount = 0 THEN 'NaN'::float8 WHEN (x.amount < 0) <> ((get_byte(float8send(x.rate), 0) & 128) <> 0) THEN '-Infinity'::float8 ELSE 'Infinity'::float8 END ELSE x.amount / x.rate END AS total FROM rates r CROSS JOIN LATERAL (VALUES ('E', r.expired, r.expired_fixing), ('P', r.premium, r.premium_fixing)) x(kind, amount, rate) ) SELECT is_contract, contract_number, client_code, derivative_type, product_code, currency, expired, premium, expired_fixing, premium_fixing, max(total) FILTER (WHERE kind = 'E') AS total_expiry, max(total) FILTER (WHERE kind = 'P') AS total_premium FROM converted GROUP BY is_contract, contract_number, client_code, derivative_type, product_code, currency, expired, premium, expired_fixing, premium_fixing ), cb_refresh_daily AS MATERIALIZED ( SELECT client_code, currency, coalesce(sum(nullif(total_expiry, 'NaN'::float8)), 0) AS expired, coalesce(sum(nullif(total_premium, 'NaN'::float8)), 0) AS premium FROM cb_refresh_converted WHERE NOT is_contract AND (abs(expired) > 1e-10 OR abs(premium) > 1e-10) GROUP BY client_code, currency ), cb_refresh_missing AS MATERIALIZED ( SELECT DISTINCT d.client_code FROM cb_refresh_daily d WHERE NOT EXISTS (SELECT FROM cb_refresh_previous p WHERE p.client_code = d.client_code AND p.currency = d.currency) AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT FROM opera.client_master_data c WHERE c.tenant_id = :tenant AND upper(btrim(c.business_unit)) = :bu AND upper(btrim(c.client_code)) = d.client_code AND lower(btrim(c.client_status)) = 'completed') ), eligible AS ( SELECT coalesce(p.client_code,d.client_code) AS client_code, coalesce(p.currency,d.currency) AS currency, coalesce(p.closing_balance,0) AS opening_balance, coalesce(nullif(d.expired,'NaN'::float8),0) AS expired, coalesce(nullif(d.premium,'NaN'::float8),0) AS premium FROM cb_refresh_previous p FULL JOIN cb_refresh_daily d ON p.client_code=d.client_code AND p.currency=d.currency WHERE p.client_code IS NOT NULL OR EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM opera.client_master_data c WHERE c.tenant_id=:tenant AND upper(trim(c.business_unit))=:bu AND upper(trim(c.client_code))=d.client_code AND lower(trim(c.client_status))='completed')), totals AS ( SELECT client_code, coalesce(sum(nullif(opening_balance,'NaN'::float8)),0) AS opening_balance, coalesce(sum(nullif(expired,'NaN'::float8)),0) AS expired, coalesce(sum(nullif(premium,'NaN'::float8)),0) AS premium FROM eligible GROUP BY client_code), manual AS ( SELECT client_code, coalesce(sum(commission),0) AS commission, coalesce(sum(transfers_in),0) AS transfers_in, coalesce(sum(transfers_out),0) AS transfers_out, coalesce(sum(interest_charges),0) AS interest_charges FROM cb_refresh_today GROUP BY client_code), nonempty_balances AS ( SELECT a.client_code, coalesce(t.currency,'USD') AS currency, a.opening_balance, a.expired AS expired_or_liquidated_cash, a.premium AS premium_paid_or_recd, coalesce(m.commission,0) AS commission, coalesce(m.transfers_in,0) AS transfers_in, coalesce(m.transfers_out,0) AS transfers_out, coalesce(m.interest_charges,0) AS interest_charges, coalesce(chosen.comments,' ') AS comments FROM totals a LEFT JOIN cb_refresh_threshold t USING(client_code) LEFT JOIN manual m USING(client_code) LEFT JOIN LATERAL (SELECT x.comments FROM cb_refresh_today x WHERE x.client_code=a.client_code ORDER BY (x.currency=coalesce(t.currency,'USD')) DESC,x.currency LIMIT 1) chosen ON true), balance_rows AS ( SELECT b.client_code,b.currency,b.opening_balance,b.expired_or_liquidated_cash,b.premium_paid_or_recd, b.commission,b.transfers_in,b.transfers_out,b.interest_charges,b.comments, b.opening_balance+b.expired_or_liquidated_cash+b.premium_paid_or_recd+b.commission +b.transfers_in+b.transfers_out+b.interest_charges AS closing_balance FROM nonempty_balances b WHERE EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM cb_refresh_input) UNION ALL SELECT p.client_code,p.currency,coalesce(p.closing_balance,0),0,0,coalesce(t.commission,0), coalesce(t.transfers_in,0),coalesce(t.transfers_out,0),coalesce(t.interest_charges,0), CASE WHEN t.client_code IS NULL THEN ' ' ELSE t.comments END, coalesce(p.closing_balance,0)+coalesce(t.commission,0) +coalesce(t.transfers_in,0)+coalesce(t.transfers_out,0)+coalesce(t.interest_charges,0) FROM cb_refresh_previous p LEFT JOIN cb_refresh_today t USING(client_code,currency) WHERE NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM cb_refresh_input) UNION ALL SELECT t.client_code,t.currency,t.opening_balance,t.expired_or_liquidated_cash,t.premium_paid_or_recd, t.commission,t.transfers_in,t.transfers_out,t.interest_charges,t.comments,t.closing_balance FROM cb_refresh_today t WHERE (EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM cb_refresh_input) AND NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM nonempty_balances b WHERE b.client_code=t.client_code)) OR (NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM cb_refresh_input) AND NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM cb_refresh_previous p WHERE p.client_code=t.client_code AND p.currency=t.currency))), contract_rows AS ( SELECT c.client_code,c.contract_number,coalesce(t.currency,'USD') AS currency, coalesce(sum(nullif(CASE WHEN abs(c.expired)<=1e-10 AND abs(c.premium)<=1e-10 THEN 0 ELSE c.total_expiry END,'NaN'::float8)),0) AS expired, coalesce(sum(nullif(CASE WHEN abs(c.expired)<=1e-10 AND abs(c.premium)<=1e-10 THEN 0 ELSE c.total_premium END,'NaN'::float8)),0) AS premium FROM cb_refresh_converted c LEFT JOIN cb_refresh_threshold t USING(client_code) WHERE c.is_contract GROUP BY c.client_code,c.contract_number,t.currency) SELECT client_code,derivative_type,product_code,currency,expired,premium FROM cb_refresh_groups WHERE NOT is_contract AND (abs(expired)>1e-10 OR abs(premium)>1e-10) AND abs(expired)<1e-7 AND abs(premium)<1e-7

WITH cb_refresh_input AS MATERIALIZED ( SELECT r.tenant_id, r.business_unit, r.trade_id, r.value_date, r.settlement_date, r.instrument, r.subportfolio, r.product_code, r.derivative_type, r.original_lots, r.active_lots, r.currency, r.transaction_date, r.maturity_date, r.contract_month, r.future_expiry, r.counterparty_parent, CASE WHEN upper(trim(r.counterparty_parent))='SIPH' AND lower(trim(r.derivative_type))='avg_swap_cc' THEN 'SIP' ELSE r.client_code END AS client_code, r.contract_number, r.original_premium, r.lot_mult, r.curr_mult, r.mult_factor, r.nc_factor, r.fx_nc_factor, r.netting_date, r.netting_status, r.opt_periodicity, r.is_premium_paid, r.fixing_date, r.settle_price, r.netted_lots FROM opera.fn_cash_balance_report_for_scope(:tenant, :bu) r WHERE r.tenant_id=:tenant AND upper(trim(r.business_unit))=:bu AND ((nullif(trim(r.client_code),'') IS NOT NULL AND lower(trim(r.client_code))<>'null') OR (upper(trim(r.counterparty_parent))='SIPH' AND lower(trim(r.derivative_type))='avg_swap_cc')) ), cb_refresh_previous AS MATERIALIZED ( SELECT upper(trim(client_code)) AS client_code, upper(trim(currency)) AS currency, opening_balance, expired_or_liquidated_cash, premium_paid_or_recd, commission, transfers_in, transfers_out, interest_charges, closing_balance, comments, client_name FROM opera.client_cash_account_balance_table WHERE tenant_id=:tenant AND upper(trim(business_unit))=:bu AND cob_date=:prevCob), cb_refresh_today AS MATERIALIZED ( SELECT upper(trim(client_code)) AS client_code, upper(trim(currency)) AS currency, opening_balance, expired_or_liquidated_cash, premium_paid_or_recd, commission, transfers_in, transfers_out, interest_charges, closing_balance, comments, client_name FROM opera.client_cash_account_balance_table WHERE tenant_id=:tenant AND upper(trim(business_unit))=:bu AND cob_date=:cob), cb_refresh_threshold AS MATERIALIZED ( SELECT upper(btrim(t.client_code)) AS client_code, coalesce(nullif(upper(btrim(t.currency)), ''), 'USD') AS currency FROM opera.client_threshold_master t WHERE t.tenant_id = :tenant AND upper(btrim(t.business_unit)) = :bu ), cb_refresh_spot AS MATERIALIZED ( SELECT upper(btrim(m.currency)) AS currency, upper(btrim(m.quantotype)) AS quantotype FROM opera.currency_spot_mapping_table m WHERE m.tenant_id = :tenant ), cb_refresh_fixings AS MATERIALIZED ( SELECT upper(btrim(f.client_code)) AS client_code, upper(btrim(f.derivative_type)) AS derivative_type, upper(btrim(f.product_code)) AS product_code, upper(btrim(f.currency)) AS currency, f.expired_fixing, f.premium_fixing FROM opera.client_account_cash_balance_fixing_table f WHERE f.tenant_id = :tenant AND upper(btrim(f.business_unit)) = :bu AND f.cob_date = :cob ), cb_refresh_movements AS MATERIALIZED ( WITH inputs AS ( SELECT upper(btrim(r.client_code)) AS client_code, upper(coalesce(btrim(r.contract_number), '')) AS contract_number, upper(coalesce(btrim(r.derivative_type), '')) AS derivative_type, upper(coalesce(btrim(r.product_code), '')) AS product_code, upper(coalesce(btrim(r.currency), '')) AS currency, coalesce(r.original_premium::float8, 0) AS original_premium, coalesce(r.original_lots::float8, 0) AS original_lots, coalesce(r.active_lots, 0) AS active_lots, coalesce(r.netted_lots, 0) AS netted_lots, coalesce(r.mult_factor, 0) AS multiplier, r.settle_price IS NOT NULL AND r.settle_price <> 'NaN'::float8 AS has_price, coalesce(nullif(r.settle_price, 'NaN'::float8), 0) AS settle_price, coalesce(r.nc_factor, 0) AS nc_factor, coalesce(r.fx_nc_factor, 0) AS fx_nc_factor, coalesce(left(lower(btrim(r.derivative_type)), 10) = 'fx_vanilla', false) AS fx_option, coalesce(left(lower(btrim(r.derivative_type)), 10) = 'fx_forward', false) AS fx_forward, coalesce(left(lower(btrim(r.derivative_type)), 8) = 'avg_swap', false) AS avg_swap, coalesce(lower(btrim(r.derivative_type)) = 'future', false) AS future, coalesce(lower(btrim(r.netting_status)), '') <> 'not_netted' AS netted, coalesce(r.is_premium_paid = 1, false) AS paid, r.maturity_date, r.transaction_date, r.netting_date FROM cb_refresh_input r ), events AS ( SELECT i.*, coalesce(fx_option AND paid AND transaction_date = :cob, false) AS fx_premium, coalesce(fx_option AND paid AND maturity_date = :cob, false) AS fx_cash, coalesce(fx_option AND NOT paid AND maturity_date = :cob, false) AS fx_realised, coalesce(fx_option AND NOT paid AND netting_date = :valueDate, false) AS fx_netted FROM inputs i ), amounts AS ( SELECT e.*, CASE WHEN fx_cash OR fx_realised THEN CASE WHEN has_price THEN -settle_price * active_lots * multiplier ELSE 0 END WHEN fx_option OR NOT has_price THEN 0 ELSE (settle_price - original_premium) * active_lots * multiplier * -1 END AS m2m_nc, CASE WHEN paid AND netting_date = :valueDate AND transaction_date IS DISTINCT FROM :cob AND derivative_type IN ('VANILLA_CALL','VANILLA_PUT','AMER_UP_IN_CALL','AMER_UP_IN_PUT', 'AMER_DOWN_IN_CALL','AMER_DOWN_IN_PUT','AMER_UP_OUT_CALL','AMER_UP_OUT_PUT', 'AMER_DOWN_OUT_CALL','AMER_DOWN_OUT_PUT','EURO_UP_OUT_CALL','EURO_DOWN_OUT_PUT', 'EURO_UP_IN_CALL','EURO_DOWN_IN_PUT','CS_SPREAD_CALL','CS_SPREAD_PUT') THEN 0 WHEN fx_netted THEN original_premium * netted_lots * multiplier WHEN fx_realised THEN original_premium * active_lots * multiplier WHEN fx_premium THEN original_premium * original_lots * multiplier WHEN fx_option THEN 0 WHEN netted AND maturity_date = :cob THEN original_premium * active_lots * multiplier WHEN netted THEN original_premium * netted_lots * multiplier ELSE original_premium * original_lots * multiplier END AS premium FROM events e ) SELECT client_code, contract_number, derivative_type, product_code, CASE WHEN fx_forward THEN 'USD' ELSE currency END AS currency, CASE WHEN future OR fx_option OR avg_swap THEN m2m_nc WHEN fx_forward THEN m2m_nc * nc_factor * fx_nc_factor ELSE 0 END AS expired, CASE WHEN NOT (future OR fx_forward OR fx_option OR avg_swap) OR fx_premium OR fx_realised OR fx_netted THEN premium ELSE 0 END AS premium FROM amounts ), cb_refresh_groups AS MATERIALIZED ( SELECT grouping(contract_number) = 0 AS is_contract, contract_number, client_code, derivative_type, product_code, currency, coalesce(sum(nullif(expired, 'NaN'::float8)), 0) AS expired, coalesce(sum(nullif(premium, 'NaN'::float8)), 0) AS premium FROM cb_refresh_movements GROUP BY GROUPING SETS ((client_code, derivative_type, product_code, currency), (contract_number, client_code, derivative_type, product_code, currency)) ), cb_refresh_converted AS MATERIALIZED ( WITH rates AS ( SELECT g.*, coalesce(f.expired_fixing, 1) AS expired_fixing, coalesce(f.premium_fixing, 1) AS premium_fixing, upper(btrim(m.quantotype)) = 'DIVISION' AS division FROM cb_refresh_groups g LEFT JOIN cb_refresh_groups retained ON NOT retained.is_contract AND retained.client_code = g.client_code AND retained.derivative_type = g.derivative_type AND retained.product_code = g.product_code AND retained.currency = g.currency AND (abs(retained.expired) > 1e-10 OR abs(retained.premium) > 1e-10) LEFT JOIN cb_refresh_fixings f ON f.client_code = g.client_code AND f.derivative_type = g.derivative_type AND f.product_code = g.product_code AND f.currency = g.currency AND (NOT g.is_contract OR retained.client_code IS NOT NULL) LEFT JOIN cb_refresh_spot m ON m.currency = g.currency ), converted AS ( SELECT r.*, x.kind, CASE WHEN NOT coalesce(division, false) THEN x.amount * x.rate WHEN x.amount = 'NaN'::float8 OR x.rate = 'NaN'::float8 THEN 'NaN'::float8 WHEN x.rate = 0 THEN CASE WHEN x.amount = 0 THEN 'NaN'::float8 WHEN (x.amount < 0) <> ((get_byte(float8send(x.rate), 0) & 128) <> 0) THEN '-Infinity'::float8 ELSE 'Infinity'::float8 END ELSE x.amount / x.rate END AS total FROM rates r CROSS JOIN LATERAL (VALUES ('E', r.expired, r.expired_fixing), ('P', r.premium, r.premium_fixing)) x(kind, amount, rate) ) SELECT is_contract, contract_number, client_code, derivative_type, product_code, currency, expired, premium, expired_fixing, premium_fixing, max(total) FILTER (WHERE kind = 'E') AS total_expiry, max(total) FILTER (WHERE kind = 'P') AS total_premium FROM converted GROUP BY is_contract, contract_number, client_code, derivative_type, product_code, currency, expired, premium, expired_fixing, premium_fixing ), cb_refresh_daily AS MATERIALIZED ( SELECT client_code, currency, coalesce(sum(nullif(total_expiry, 'NaN'::float8)), 0) AS expired, coalesce(sum(nullif(total_premium, 'NaN'::float8)), 0) AS premium FROM cb_refresh_converted WHERE NOT is_contract AND (abs(expired) > 1e-10 OR abs(premium) > 1e-10) GROUP BY client_code, currency ), cb_refresh_missing AS MATERIALIZED ( SELECT DISTINCT d.client_code FROM cb_refresh_daily d WHERE NOT EXISTS (SELECT FROM cb_refresh_previous p WHERE p.client_code = d.client_code AND p.currency = d.currency) AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT FROM opera.client_master_data c WHERE c.tenant_id = :tenant AND upper(btrim(c.business_unit)) = :bu AND upper(btrim(c.client_code)) = d.client_code AND lower(btrim(c.client_status)) = 'completed') ), eligible AS ( SELECT coalesce(p.client_code,d.client_code) AS client_code, coalesce(p.currency,d.currency) AS currency, coalesce(p.closing_balance,0) AS opening_balance, coalesce(nullif(d.expired,'NaN'::float8),0) AS expired, coalesce(nullif(d.premium,'NaN'::float8),0) AS premium FROM cb_refresh_previous p FULL JOIN cb_refresh_daily d ON p.client_code=d.client_code AND p.currency=d.currency WHERE p.client_code IS NOT NULL
